summary: Well-structured test suite covering all core requirements: cartesian product expansion, include/exclude merging, strategy options (max-parallel, fail-fast), size validation, CLI behavior, and GitHub Actions workflow structure. Tests are organized with clear Describe blocks, use fixtures for realistic scenarios, and include the canonical GitHub fruit/animal include example. Includes both unit tests (MatrixGenerator.Tests, Generate-Matrix.Tests) and workflow structural tests. Integration validation handled via Run-ActTests.ps1 harness which captures act output and asserts exact expected matrix combinations. Minor gaps: expected Pester count (35) appears off from actual test count (~40-50 total); lacks exhaustive edge cases (special characters, unicode, very large matrices, null values); fixture file discovery could be clearer. Would catch most regressions in implementation but misses some boundary conditions.
